title: Water Leak Detector with Flow Pattern Learning
description: Learns a household's normal water flow pattern from a pulse flow meter and raises an alert for continuous low flow that suggests a leak, tested with deliberately simulated drips.

title: Wearable Fall Detector with Threshold and Posture Checks
description: Uses an accelerometer to spot falls by combining impact, free fall and lying posture checks, and measures false alarms during everyday movements recorded by volunteers. Includes a written safety note.
